description:
Lifecycle growth experiments sprint is a 4-week, cross-functional Go-to-Market + Product sprint at Redwood Inference focused on improving self-serve activation and early retention for the Hosted API. The sprint tests (1) onboarding email sequences, (2) in-console onboarding nudges, and (3) paid retargeting campaigns, with shared instrumentation and a consistent measurement framework.

Goals:
- Lift activation rate (primary: % of new signups completing a “first successful request” and “first 100k tokens” milestone within 7 days).
- Reduce time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-to-value for new developers.
- Improve short-term retention (D7/D30 active usage) and downstream conversion signals (upgrade intent, sales-assisted handoffs when appropriate).

Scope:
- Email: new lifecycle drip (copy + timing + trigger logic), deliverability checks, unsubscribe/compliance handling, and segmentation (new users, stalled users, first-success users).
- Console: contextual “next best action” nudges (API key creation, first request, enable streaming, view usage dashboard), feature-flagged targeting, and UX/copy iteration.
- Retargeting: audience definitions (site visitors, signup-no-activation, activated-but-no-return), creative briefs, UTM conventions, spend caps, and guardrails to avoid targeting active enterprise opportunities.
- Measurement: event taxonomy, funnel dashboard, experiment design (A/B or holdout), and readouts with decision criteria.

Out of scope:
- Major product re-architecture, pricing changes, or large-scale docs replatforming. Any engineering work is limited to instrumentation, lightweight UI components, and feature flags needed for experiments.

Stakeholders & roles:
- Growth/Marketing: Ben Carter (experiment owner), Camila Reyes (exec sponsor), Soojin Lee (messaging review).
- Product: Marissa Cole (console surface area), Paula Mendes (telemetry/rollouts input).
- Engineering partners: Console/Platform engineers for eventing, feature flags, and nudge components; Observability owner for dashboards.
- Sales leadership: Jordan Blake / Stephanie Nguyen for audience exclusions and handoff rules.

Timeline & deliverables:
- Week 1: KPI definitions + event spec + email v2 copy + launch first email A/B.
- Week 2: console nudge framework + QA + first nudge experiment.
- Week 3: retargeting launch + spend/CPA monitoring + audience refinement.
- Week 4: consolidated analysis + recommendations (keep/iterate/kill) + follow-on backlog.

Constraints/guardrails:
- Compliance: CAN-SPAM/GDPR unsubscribe handling; conservative retargeting audiences; data handling documented.
- Deliverability: throttle ramps, domain reputation monitoring.
- Experiment integrity: consistent event definitions, holdouts, and clear stop/go thresholds to avoid noisy conclusions.
